I need to clarify your symptoms: when did the fever and flank pain start relative to your recent antibiotic treatment for sinusitis, and do you notice any changes in your urination?

REQUEST TEST: Urinalysis, CBC, CRP
REQUEST TEST: Blood_Culture

speaker: Doctor
text:
Since your urine, blood counts, and cultures are all normal despite your fever and flank pain, have you noticed any redness or tenderness along your spine or anywhere else on your body?

REQUEST IMAGES: Spine_X-Ray, MRI_Spine

speaker: Patient
text: I have been feeling tired, feverish, and I have flank pain. These symptoms continued even after my sinus symptoms improved.

speaker: Doctor
text: Has the fever and flank pain persisted for more than 24 hours despite your recent antibiotics, and do you have any history of kidney stones or recent skin infections like a boil or cat scratch?

speaker: Patient
text: I was first treated with amoxicillin for sinusitis and developed a rash. Then the antibiotic was changed to cephalexin for another week, and the rash went away.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Disseminated Histoplasmosis secondary to amoxicillin rash. The timeline of fever, flank pain, and fatigue persisting after antibiotics, combined with a rash reaction to Amoxicillin (suggesting possible immune dysregulation or co-infection), points toward an opportunistic fungal infection like Histoplasmosis which can cause fever, flank pain, and fatigue. I recommend requesting Histoplasma antigen testing and a Chest X-Ray to confirm.
